verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair question for a hosted API proxy that relays agent requests and holds team credentials. Nothing in the evidence pack documents retention periods, deletion of call logs or account data, or any user-facing retention controls. Self-hosting (treg-gh-3) is a deployment option, not a documented retention or deletion capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
